about_item: 4 Mics with AI-ENx Technology: Enjoy noise-free calling with AI-ENx technology in the boAt Airdopes Prime 412 TWS Earbuds. Integrated with 4 mics, these earbuds make communication easy no matter where you are.

Multipoint Connectivity: Hustle like a pro as you switch between phone calls and laptop meetings with multipoint connectivity. Stay connected to two devices at the same time with your Airdopes and breeze through your routine.

boAt Hearables App Support: boAt Hearables app compatibility brings novelty functions like battery and connectivity status, feature control toggle, etc., at your fingertips for next-level listening with your Airdopes.
Massive 50 hours Playback: Tune into non-stop audio fun with the massive playtime. Groove, stream, and game for up to 50 hours with your unwavering audio companion!
ASAP Charge: ASAP Charge your buds for merely 10 minutes and kickstart entertainment with a massive 240 minutes of playtime.
Google Fast Pair: Forget manual pairing woes with Google Fast Pair’s rapid one-tap connectivity. Additionally, you can personalize the pairing name for your Airdopes or even locate misplaced buds.
11 mm Drivers with boAt Signature Sound: Escape the chaos and jam to thumping boAt Signature Sound from the dual 11 mm drivers in these earbuds.

Advanced Bluetooth v5.4: Make tiresome traveling fun with a dose of music. You can even tune into live sports games and kill time like a pro. The Bluetooth v5.4 compatibility of these earbuds lends wireless audio comfort for up to 10 m.

Gaming BEAST Mode: Show off your skills in the virtual arena with the dedicated BEAST mode for gaming. Sneak up on your opponents with winning moves seamlessly as the 60 ms low latency gets rid of pesky lag.

IPX5 Water Resistance: Enjoy your tunes at the gym, beach, poolside, and more, as Airdopes Prime 412 is designed with IPX5 resistance to keep sweat and splashes away from playing spoilsport to your fun.

summary.text: Customers find the earbuds' sound quality amazing and appreciate their excellent battery life. The Bluetooth connectivity receives mixed feedback - while some say it's good, others report poor connection issues. Moreover, the product's reliability is concerning, with multiple customers reporting that one of the earpods stops working within a month. Additionally, the fit and noise cancellation receive mixed reviews, with some saying they fit well while others disagree, and while some find the noise cancellation effective, others say it's not that great. The value for money is also mixed, with some considering it worth the price while others disagree.

authors_reviews.text: The Earbuds is very good in look , colour and finishing.Very good earbuds. Everyone knows about Boat brand .Earbuds fill in hand is very good.The Bluetooth connectivity is strong and quick, with no lag or interruptions.Good battery life of the Earbuds . Very good durability. Very good sound Earbuds with bass that's incredibly deep and powerful - it literally shakes my ears.Does not pain to Ears unlike other earbuds does. Very Light waight earbuds. On charging case remaining charging in earbuds indicators is present. Very good deal.Good for it.
authors_reviews.author: Ashish

authors_reviews.title: Disappointed
authors_reviews.text: The sound quality is disappointing. Bass is weak, audio output feels low-quality, and the in-ear detection feature does not work properly. At this price point, there are many other brands that offer much better performance and features.I regret relying on the BOAT Airdopes Prime 512. The replacement policy is also frustrating, as replacements are only provided under limited predefined conditions. Upgrading to a better product is not an option. Overall, a disappointing purchase and a poor after-sales experience.
authors_reviews.author: Supratim
